historical_metadata.experiment_config: recovered per run under runs[].config by matching the deterministic run_id hash (verified); null if no match

environment_at_freeze.note: Current values when this baseline was created. NOT the values Phase I ran with.

question_config.instructions: Select the intent that best represents the user's request.
question_config.criteria: one entry per example candidate, each with value None

canonical.rule: Identity = (run_id, provider, example_id, locale). For every identity with >1 row, keep only the LATEST row (highest raw row position) and drop the earlier ones. The rule uses row order only, never the prediction or its correctness, so it cannot bias the canonical set. Whether repeated calls agreed is recorded separately in canonical_dedup_report.csv as evidence of decision stability.
canonical.note: Use canonical_results.parquet for all Phase II analysis; the raw frozen files are for provenance only. Disagreements are evidence of decision instability, not removed rows.
